# Tablet App for Mac

> Free, open-source (GPL-3.0) settings app for drawing tablets on macOS 15 or later (Apple silicon), built on OpenTabletDriver. Current version: Version 17.

Tested only with macOS 27.0.1 and a Wacom Intuos4 Small (PTK-440).

## Download and install

- [Download for Mac (silicon) (Tablet-App-for-Mac.dmg)](https://github.com/DigitalGroceries/tablet-app-for-mac/releases/latest/download/Tablet-App-for-Mac.dmg): latest, tested.
- [Install steps](https://digitalgroceries.github.io/tablet-app-for-mac/#get): open the .dmg, drag Tablet App for Mac to Applications, open it (if macOS warns: right-click › Open, or System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway). Allow Input Monitoring and Accessibility.

## Source

- [Source code repository](https://github.com/DigitalGroceries/tablet-app-for-mac)
- [Build steps](https://digitalgroceries.github.io/tablet-app-for-mac/source/): .NET 10 SDK; `dotnet publish OpenTabletArtist/OpenTabletArtist.csproj -c Release -r osx-arm64 --self-contained true`
- [Repository layout (AGENTS.md)](https://github.com/DigitalGroceries/tablet-app-for-mac/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- [Licence: GNU GPL v3.0](https://github.com/DigitalGroceries/tablet-app-for-mac/blob/main/LICENSE); the bundled OpenTabletDriver is LGPL-3.0.
